question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

One of the most significant reforms [that has transformed] the education sector in recent years was introduced by the previous government.
explanation: 'One of the + plural noun + that/who' में relative pronoun का antecedent plural noun (reforms) होता है, इसलिए उसकी verb plural आती है: 'that have transformed'। Main verb 'was introduced' 'One' के साथ singular ही रहती है।

question:
Spot the error.

Not only the principal but also the teachers of the junior wing was invited (A) / to the ceremony that the district administration organised (B) / on the occasion of the annual day last week. (C)

options.text: Not only the principal but also the teachers of the junior wing was invited
to the ceremony that the district administration organised
on the occasion of the annual day last week.

explanation: 'Not only...but also' में verb nearest subject के अनुसार लगती है। Nearest subject 'teachers' plural है, इसलिए 'was invited' → 'were invited'।

question:
Spot the error.

More than one candidate (A) / who appeared for the interview (B) / has been shortlisted for the final round. (C)

options.text: has been shortlisted for the final round.

explanation: 'More than one + singular noun' के साथ singular verb आती है (अर्थ plural होने पर भी)। इसलिए 'has been shortlisted' सही है, sentence में कोई error नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The Prime Minister, accompanied by several senior ministers and a large delegation of businessmen, [is expected to] arrive in Tokyo tomorrow morning.
explanation: 'Accompanied by / along with / as well as' से subject plural नहीं बनता। Subject 'The Prime Minister' singular है, इसलिए 'is expected to' सही है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Two-thirds of the land in the coastal villages [have been] submerged by the recent floods, leaving thousands of farmers homeless.
explanation: Fraction + of + singular/uncountable noun के साथ singular verb आती है (plural noun के साथ plural)। यहाँ 'land' singular है, इसलिए 'has been submerged'।

question:
Spot the error.

The committee has submitted its report on time, (A) / but the government has not yet responded, and (B) / several of its members is not satisfied with the recommendations. (C)

options.text: The committee has submitted its report on time,
but the government has not yet responded, and
several of its members is not satisfied with the recommendations.

explanation: 'Several' plural quantifier है, इसलिए 'several of its members' plural subject है। 'is not satisfied' → 'are not satisfied'।

question:
Spot the error.

In a press conference held yesterday, (A) / the proprietor and manager of the company have decided (B) / to expand the business into the neighbouring states. (C)

options.text: In a press conference held yesterday,
the proprietor and manager of the company have decided
to expand the business into the neighbouring states.

explanation: एक ही article 'the' के साथ दो nouns (proprietor and manager) एक ही व्यक्ति के लिए होते हैं, इसलिए verb singular आएगी: 'has decided'।

question:
Spot the error.

The villagers have already moved to a safer place on higher ground (A) / by the time the rescue team (B) / arrived at the site. (C)

options.text: The villagers have already moved to a safer place on higher ground
by the time the rescue team

explanation: 'By the time + Simple Past' के साथ main clause में Past Perfect आता है। 'have already moved' → 'had already moved'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He [has been working] as a surgeon for twenty years when he decided to leave the profession and start teaching.
explanation: Past में लिए गए निर्णय से पहले चल रही लंबी action के लिए Past Perfect Continuous (had been working) आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

Corruption has become a menace in every department, (A) / and it is high time that (B) / the government takes strict action against it. (C)

options.text: Corruption has become a menace in every department,
and it is high time that
the government takes strict action against it.

explanation: 'It is (high) time' के बाद Simple Past आता है: 'the government took strict action'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The students [have been waiting] for the results since morning, but the university has not yet announced them.
explanation: 'Since + point of time' (since morning) के साथ Present Perfect Continuous आता है, इसलिए sentence पहले से सही है।

question:
Spot the error.

He told me yesterday that he is going to attend the conference (A) / in Mumbai the following week (B) / and would stay there for a few days. (C)

options.text: He told me yesterday that he is going to attend the conference
and would stay there for a few days.

explanation: Reporting verb (told) past में है और 'the following week' reported speech का marker है, इसलिए 'is going' → 'was going'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new software will be launched in the market by the end of this month, provided that all the tests [will be completed] successfully.
explanation: Time/condition clause (if, provided that, when, unless) में future के लिए Simple Present आता है, 'will' नहीं: 'provided that all the tests are completed'।

question:
Spot the error.

The residents of the colony (A) / have been complaining to the municipal corporation (B) / about the irregular supply of water since last month. (C)

options.text: have been complaining to the municipal corporation
about the irregular supply of water since last month.

explanation: 'Complain to (person) about (matter)' और 'since last month' के साथ Present Perfect Continuous दोनों सही हैं, इसलिए कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The committee has not yet decided whether to comply to the new guidelines (A) / issued by the regulatory authority (B) / for the telecom sector. (C)

options.text: The committee has not yet decided whether to comply to the new guidelines

explanation: 'Comply' के साथ preposition 'with' आता है: 'comply with the new guidelines'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The Prime Minister held a meeting with the senior officials to [discuss about] the measures to control inflation.
explanation: 'Discuss' transitive verb है, इसके बाद preposition (about/on/over) नहीं लगता।

question:
Spot the error.

After a long investigation, (A) / the police have arrested the former director (B) / who was accused for misappropriating funds meant for the employees. (C)

options.text: the police have arrested the former director
who was accused for misappropriating funds meant for the employees.

explanation: 'Accuse' के साथ preposition 'of' आता है: 'accused of misappropriating'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

My sister is very fond [with] classical music, and she has been attending concerts since her school days.
explanation: 'Fond' के बाद 'of' आता है: 'fond of classical music'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The delegation [reached to] the airport late in the evening after a long and tiring journey.
explanation: 'Reach' transitive verb है, इसके बाद preposition नहीं आता (reach to/at/in गलत)। सही: 'reached the airport'।

question:
Spot the error.

During my stay in Switzerland, (A) / I visited many places, but this is the most beautiful one (B) / which I have ever seen in my life. (C)

options.text: I visited many places, but this is the most beautiful one
which I have ever seen in my life.

explanation: Superlative degree के बाद relative pronoun 'that' आता है, 'which' नहीं: 'the most beautiful one that I have ever seen'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I was surprised at [him being selected] for the post despite his poor performance in the written test and the interview.
explanation: Gerund (being selected) से पहले possessive case आता है: 'surprised at his being selected'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The multinational company has announced [it's] annual bonus for all its employees on the eve of the festival.
explanation: 'It's' = it is / it has होता है। Possession दिखाने के लिए 'its' (बिना apostrophe) आता है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

No one in the entire team is as dedicated to the work [as him], and everyone in the department acknowledges this fact.
explanation: 'as / than' के बाद nominative case आता है क्योंकि अधूरा clause होता है ('as he is dedicated')। इसलिए 'as him' → 'as he is'।

question:
Spot the error.

He left for the railway station (A) / after having the breakfast with his family (B) / to catch the morning train to Lucknow. (C)

options.text: He left for the railway station
after having the breakfast with his family
to catch the morning train to Lucknow.

explanation: Meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) के नाम से पहले general sense में article नहीं लगता: 'after having breakfast'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She is [a such talented] singer that every leading music director wants to work with her.
explanation: 'Such' का स्थान 'a/an' से पहले होता है: 'such + a + adjective + noun'।

question:
Spot the error.

The Government has launched (A) / a scheme for the poor (B) / and the needy in the rural areas. (C)

options.text: and the needy in the rural areas.

explanation: 'The + adjective' plural common noun बनाता है (the poor, the needy), और दोनों के साथ 'the' सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The committee asked the officials to provide farther details (A) / regarding the expenditure incurred (B) / on the project. (C)

options.text: The committee asked the officials to provide farther details

explanation: 'Farther' दूरी के लिए और 'further' अतिरिक्त (additional) के अर्थ में आता है: 'further details'।

question:
Spot the error.

The climate of the hill stations in the northern region (A) / is much pleasanter during the summer months (B) / than the plains. (C)

options.text: The climate of the hill stations in the northern region
is much pleasanter during the summer months

explanation: तुलना एक जैसी चीज़ों की होनी चाहिए: climate की तुलना climate से। सही: 'than that of the plains'।

question:
Spot the error.

The audit report clearly states that (A) / the reason why the project was delayed is because (B) / the funds were not released on time. (C)

options.text: The audit report clearly states that
the reason why the project was delayed is because
the funds were not released on time.

explanation: 'The reason ... is that' आता है। 'Reason' के साथ 'because' लगाना redundancy है: 'is that the funds were not released'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The more you practise, [the more confident] you will become in the examination hall.
explanation: 'The + comparative ..., the + comparative' structure यहाँ सही है, इसलिए कोई improvement नहीं चाहिए।

question:
Spot the error.

The old man walked very slowly (A) / lest he should not (B) / fall down and injure himself. (C)

options.text: The old man walked very slowly

explanation: 'Lest' में negative अर्थ पहले से है, इसलिए 'not' नहीं लगता: 'lest he should fall'।

question:
Spot the error.

The new policy will benefit neither the farmers or the traders, (A) / since it fails to address (B) / the core issues of the agricultural market. (C)

options.text: The new policy will benefit neither the farmers or the traders,
the core issues of the agricultural market.

explanation: 'Neither' के साथ 'nor' आता है, 'or' नहीं: 'neither the farmers nor the traders'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The newly appointed officer behaves [like] he were the owner of the entire department.
explanation: Clause से पहले 'like' conjunction का काम नहीं करता। 'As if / as though' आता है (साथ में subjunctive 'were')।

question:
Spot the error.

Though we were his guests and had repeatedly objected, (A) / our host did not listen to us and (B) / insisted to pay the entire bill himself. (C)

options.text: Though we were his guests and had repeatedly objected,
our host did not listen to us and
insisted to pay the entire bill himself.

explanation: 'Insist' के बाद 'on + gerund' आता है: 'insisted on paying'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The officer, when questioned about the missing files, [denied to have] any knowledge of them and refused to sign the statement.
explanation: 'Deny' के बाद gerund (V+ing) आता है, infinitive नहीं: 'denied having'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He could not help [laughing] when he saw the comical attire worn by the chief guest.
explanation: 'Cannot help' के बाद V+ing आती है, इसलिए 'laughing' सही है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The ancient temple located on the hilltop is certainly [worth to visit] if you ever come to this region.
explanation: 'Worth' के बाद V+ing आती है: 'worth visiting'।

question:
Spot the error.

If the students would have followed the instructions (A) / given by the teacher, they (B) / would have performed much better in the test. (C)

options.text: If the students would have followed the instructions
would have performed much better in the test.

explanation: Third conditional: If + had + V3, would have + V3। 'If' वाले clause में 'would have' नहीं लगता: 'If the students had followed'।

question:
Spot the error.

The doctor suggested that the patient (A) / takes complete rest (B) / for at least two weeks. (C)

options.text: The doctor suggested that the patient

explanation: Suggest, insist, demand, recommend जैसे verbs के बाद 'that' clause में subjunctive (V1) आता है: 'that the patient take complete rest'।

question:
Spot the error.

Had it not been for (A) / your timely help, I would have (B) / lost all my money in that deal. (C)

options.text: your timely help, I would have
lost all my money in that deal.

explanation: Inverted third conditional 'Had it not been for ..., I would have + V3' बिल्कुल सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

After a long deliberation, the council has appointed three (A) / commander-in-chiefs from the different regions (B) / to supervise the military operations along the border. (C)

options.text: After a long deliberation, the council has appointed three
to supervise the military operations along the border.

explanation: Compound noun में plural main word में लगता है: 'commanders-in-chief'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Many a promising student in the rural areas [have failed] to clear the competitive examinations because of the lack of proper guidance.
explanation: 'Many a + singular noun' के साथ singular verb आती है: 'Many a student has failed'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The shopkeeper showed me a red shirt, but I did not like it, so I asked him to show [other one].
explanation: 'Another' = an + other; singular countable noun के साथ 'another one' आता है, 'other one' नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The old man was so weak that (A) / he could not hardly walk (B) / without the help of his grandson. (C)

options.text: The old man was so weak that
without the help of his grandson.

explanation: 'Hardly' खुद negative अर्थ रखता है, इसलिए 'not' के साथ double negative बनता है: 'he could hardly walk'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The boy is [enough old] to understand the consequences of his actions, so he should be held responsible.
explanation: 'Enough' adjective/adverb के बाद आता है: 'old enough'।

question:
Spot the error.

The examination has been postponed by a week, (A) / so the candidates have enough time (B) / and need not to worry about it now. (C)

options.text: The examination has been postponed by a week,
so the candidates have enough time
and need not to worry about it now.

explanation: 'Need' जब modal की तरह प्रयोग हो तो उसके बाद bare infinitive आता है ('to' नहीं): 'need not worry'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The students who had been found guilty of indiscipline [were made clean] the entire school ground by the headmaster as a punishment.
explanation: 'Make' के बाद active में bare infinitive आता है (made them clean), पर passive में 'to + V1' आता है: 'were made to clean'।

question:
Spot the error.

The teacher asked the students that why they had not completed (A) / the homework given the previous day (B) / and warned them of strict action. (C)

options.text: The teacher asked the students that why they had not completed
the homework given the previous day
and warned them of strict action.

explanation: Wh-question की reported speech में 'that' नहीं लगता: 'asked the students why they had not completed'।

question:
Spot the error.

Seldom does the Chief Minister visit the remote villages of the district (A) / and listen to the problems (B) / faced by the local people. (C)

options.text: Seldom does the Chief Minister visit the remote villages of the district

explanation: Seldom / Rarely / Never से वाक्य शुरू होने पर inversion (auxiliary + subject) आता है, इसलिए 'Seldom does the Chief Minister visit' सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Walking along the beach in the early morning, (A) / a beautiful shell was found (B) / by the little girl. (C)

options.text: Walking along the beach in the early morning,

explanation: Dangling modifier: 'Walking...' का doer 'the little girl' होना चाहिए, 'shell' नहीं। सही: 'the little girl found a beautiful shell'।
